description_short: Among low-temperature (< 70 °C) runs with thin coatings (< 20 nm) in comparison R1469594, list support, precursor pair, temperature, thickness, and classify alumina-like GPC as slow/average/fast when TMA-based precursors are used.

paper.title: Atomic layer deposition on particulate materials from 1988 through 2023: A quantitative review of technologies, materials and applications

postprocessing_notes.gpc_interpretation: For TMA-based precursor pairs (approximate alumina-like processes), numeric GPC values are classified as slow (< 0.4 nm), average (0.4–1.0 nm), or fast (> 1.0 nm). Non-alumina-like rows or missing GPC values are labeled 'n/a'.
